name: Window Management
user_story: As a user, I want the app to open with proper window sizing and layout
expected_behavior: Window opens at 1200x750 default, min 900x600, fills screen when maximized

name: Menu Bar Commands
user_story: As a user, I want standard keyboard shortcuts for Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All
expected_behavior: Cmd+X/C/V/A work in all text fields via NSApp.sendAction

name: New Task Command
user_story: As a user, I want Cmd+N to create a new task
expected_behavior: Cmd+N calls appState.startNewTask(in: selectedWorkspace) and clears the chat

name: Search Command
user_story: As a user, I want Cmd+K to open search palette
expected_behavior: Cmd+K sets appState.showSearch = true which opens SearchPaletteView sheet

name: Workspace List Display
user_story: As a user, I want to see all my workspaces in the left sidebar
expected_behavior: Workspaces displayed in list or grid view, sorted by chosen order, filtered by query

name: Workspace Section Header
user_story: As a user, I want to expand/collapse the workspaces section
expected_behavior: Click chevron toggles workspacesSectionExpanded; sort/filter/search/view-mode buttons visible

name: Workspace Sort
user_story: As a user, I want to sort workspaces by name (A-Z/Z-A), recent use, or task count
expected_behavior: Sort menu in section header cycles through WorkspaceSortOrder options

name: Workspace Filter
user_story: As a user, I want to search/filter workspaces by name
expected_behavior: Toggle search field via magnifying glass icon; filters via SidebarWorkspaceLogic.filtered

name: Workspace View Mode
user_story: As a user, I want to toggle between list and grid view of workspaces
expected_behavior: Toggle button switches workspaceViewMode between .list and .grid

name: Workspace Selection
user_story: As a user, I want to click a workspace to select it and see its sessions
expected_behavior: Clicking workspace sets selectedWorkspace; expand/collapse sessions below

name: Session List per Workspace
user_story: As a user, I want to see sessions/tasks under each workspace
expected_behavior: Expanded workspace shows up to 12 sessions sorted by updatedAt descending

name: Session Selection
user_story: As a user, I want to click a session to open it in the chat
expected_behavior: Tap session row calls appState.selectSession(session); loads messages

name: New Task from Sidebar
user_story: As a user, I want to create a new task from the sidebar
expected_behavior: New Task action row (Cmd+N) or hover + button on workspace row

name: New Project
user_story: As a user, I want to create a new project from the sidebar
expected_behavior: New Project button (Cmd+Shift+P) opens NewProjectSheet with name/path/NSOpenPanel

name: Navigation History
user_story: As a user, I want back/forward navigation between workspaces
expected_behavior: Left/right chevron buttons navigate workspace history stack

name: Sidebar Toggle
user_story: As a user, I want to show/hide the sidebar
expected_behavior: Sidebar icon button toggles appState.sidebarVisible

name: User Profile
user_story: As a user, I want to see my user avatar/initials and name in the sidebar footer
expected_behavior: Shows circle with initials + displayName at bottom of sidebar

name: Notifications Button
user_story: As a user, I want to open notifications from sidebar footer
expected_behavior: Bell icon opens NotificationsSheet (currently shows empty state)

name: Settings Button
user_story: As a user, I want to open settings from sidebar footer
expected_behavior: Gear icon calls appState.openSettings()

name: Workspace Hover Actions
user_story: As a user, I want + and ... buttons on workspace hover
expected_behavior: Hovering workspace shows 'New task' and context menu (Open in Finder, New task)

name: Session Hover Actions
user_story: As a user, I want + and ... buttons on session hover
expected_behavior: Hovering session shows plus button and context menu

name: Workspaces Overview
user_story: As a user, I want to see all workspaces in an overview sheet
expected_behavior: Button in section header opens WorkspacesOverviewSheet with search and list

name: Chat Panel Layout
user_story: As a user, I want the chat area to show messages or initial empty state
expected_behavior: If no messages, show EmptyChatStateView; if messages exist, show scrollable message list

name: Empty State Logo
user_story: As a user, I want to see the MiMo logo on the initial screen
expected_behavior: MiMoLogoMark(size: 140) shown centered when no messages exist

name: Empty State Title
user_story: As a user, I want to see contextual text on the empty screen
expected_behavior: Dynamic text: session title > workspace name > 'Select a workspace' fallback

name: Message List Display
user_story: As a user, I want to see all messages in a scrollable chat
expected_behavior: LazyVStack of messages with work-time separators, auto-scroll to bottom

name: Work Time Separators
user_story: As a user, I want time separators between messages with >5s gap
expected_behavior: 'Worked for Xm Ys' label shown between messages sent >5s apart

name: Auto-scroll to Bottom
user_story: As a user, I want the chat to auto-scroll when new messages arrive
expected_behavior: Scrolls to bottom anchor when at bottom and new content appears

name: Scroll-to-Bottom Button
user_story: As a user, I want a floating button to jump to the latest message
expected_behavior: Chevron-down circle button appears when scrolled up from bottom

name: Load Older Messages
user_story: As a user, I want to load older messages via button or auto-load
expected_behavior: 'Load earlier messages' button or auto-onAppear loads more via pagination

name: Centered Input Card
user_story: As a user, I want a centered input card on the initial screen
expected_behavior: Rounded capsule with workspace header, text field, toolbar; animated expansion

name: Auto-Growing Text Field
user_story: As a user, I want the text field to grow as I type (up to 80% screen on initial screen)
expected_behavior: CompactMessageTextField grows via ZeroInsetTextField NSTextView; maxHeight = InputLayout.textMaxHeight (72) or 80% on initial screen

name: Workspace Dropdown
user_story: As a user, I want to change workspace from the input card
expected_behavior: Workspace header button opens dropdown with searchable workspace list + Open folder + Remote connect

name: Access Level Menu
user_story: As a user, I want to set the access level (ask/edit/bash/webfetch)
expected_behavior: Menu with icons and descriptions for each access level; persists to UserDefaults

name: Agent Mode Menu
user_story: As a user, I want to switch between Build/Plan/Compose agent modes
expected_behavior: Menu shows modes; Plan disabled if model doesn't support plan agent

name: Provider Selector
user_story: As a user, I want to select a provider from available options
expected_behavior: Menu showing server providers and custom providers with names and status

name: Model Selector
user_story: As a user, I want to select a model for the current provider
expected_behavior: Menu showing models for selected provider; checkmark on current selection

name: Variant Selector
user_story: As a user, I want to select a variant (reasoning effort) for the model
expected_behavior: Menu shows available variants like high/medium/low when model supports reasoning

name: Plus Menu (Attachments)
user_story: As a user, I want to add files and images via the + button
expected_behavior: Popover with File and Photo options; opens NSOpenPanel or .fileImporter

name: Send Button
user_story: As a user, I want to send the message or stop generation
expected_behavior: Button shows arrow (send) when idle or stop square when loading/streaming

name: Message Queue Indicator
user_story: As a user, I want to see queued messages when I send while already loading
expected_behavior: Pending messages shown as numbered list in input card

name: Attachment Preview
user_story: As a user, I want to see attached files and images before sending
expected_behavior: ComposerAttachmentPreview shows file names and image thumbnails

name: Bottom Input Bar
user_story: As a user, I want the input bar at the bottom when conversation exists
expected_behavior: Compact bar with text field (single-line until typing), toolbar, divider

name: Dangerous command detection (Future)
user_story: As a user, I want warnings before sending dangerous commands
expected_behavior: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — regex patterns TBD, marked as future feature

name: User Message Sending
user_story: As a user, I want to send a text message and see it appear
expected_behavior: Message appended to store; sent via mimoClient.sendMessage; shows as user bubble

name: Assistant Streaming Response
user_story: As a user, I want to see the assistant's response stream in real-time
expected_behavior: SSE events from server update message content incrementally via handleSSEEvent

name: Stop Generation
user_story: As a user, I want to stop the assistant's response
expected_behavior: Stop button calls stopGeneration → abort session via SSE abort

name: Message Edit
user_story: As a user, I want to edit a sent message
expected_behavior: EditMessage notification loads draft into composer; canEdit checks isFinished

name: Message Resend
user_story: As a user, I want to resend a message
expected_behavior: ResendMessage notification triggers sendDirectly with same content

name: Message Retry
user_story: As a user, I want to retry the last assistant message
expected_behavior: Retry finds preceding user message and resends it

name: Copy Entire Chat
user_story: As a user, I want to copy the entire conversation transcript
expected_behavior: copyEntireChat notification generates transcript via ChatCopyLogic and puts on clipboard

name: Message Content Sanitization
user_story: As a user, I want system-reminder tags stripped from displayed messages
expected_behavior: MessageContentSanitizerLogic removes <system-reminder> blocks, nil for pure-reminder parts

name: Thinking/Reasoning Spoiler
user_story: As a user, I want to see the assistant's thinking in an expandable spoiler
expected_behavior: ThinkingSpoilerView toggles expand/collapse for reasoning content

name: Tool Call Display
user_story: As a user, I want to see tool calls with status, args, and results
expected_behavior: ToolCallPresentationLogic formats name/args/result; inspector shows header+copy+status

name: Tool Inspector
user_story: As a user, I want to inspect tool call details
expected_behavior: SplitToolInspectorView shows tool name, arguments, result, completion status

name: Image Display in Chat
user_story: As a user, I want to see images inline in messages
expected_behavior: TappableChatImage shows thumbnail; full-size on click

name: Markdown Rendering
user_story: As a user, I want messages rendered with Markdown formatting
expected_behavior: MarkdownTextView renders bold, italic, code blocks, etc.

name: Question/Answer Cards
user_story: As a user, I want to answer questions from the plan agent during a task
expected_behavior: PlanQuestionCardView shows questions with options; answers sent via replyToQuestion

name: Server Provider Discovery
user_story: As a user, I want models loaded from MiMo Serve /config/providers
expected_behavior: loadModelsFromServer fetches providers via mimoClient.providers() and populates serverProviders

name: Custom Provider Configuration
user_story: As a user, I want to add custom providers with name/type/URL/apiKey
expected_behavior: AddProviderSheet form with type picker, name, URL, API key, toggles; saved to UserDefaults

name: Custom Provider RequiresAPIKey Toggle
user_story: As a user, I want to mark a provider as not requiring an API key (e.g. local models)
expected_behavior: Requires API Key toggle in AddProviderSheet; when off, MiMo Serve not required for sending

name: Provider Cascade/Resolution
user_story: As a user, I want the system to resolve the right provider for a model
expected_behavior: ProviderSettingsLogic.resolveProviderID searches serverProviders then customProviders

name: Capability Gates
user_story: As a user, I want the UI to show only compatible models for my agent mode
expected_behavior: ProviderCapabilityGates checks reasoning/toolcall/plan capabilities before allowing selection

name: Model Variants
user_story: As a user, I want to select reasoning effort variants for compatible models
expected_behavior: Variants shown when model has capabilities.reasoning == true and variants dict non-empty

name: API Key Management
user_story: As a user, I want my API keys stored securely
expected_behavior: KeychainManager stores/retrieves/deletes API keys; fallback file for CI

name: Connection Validation
user_story: As a user, I want clear errors if I try to send without a valid provider/model
expected_behavior: SendReadinessLogic checks serverConnected, modelID, providerID; returns descriptive errors

name: Test Connection
user_story: As a user, I want to test if my provider URL/key works
expected_behavior: Test Connection button hits {baseURL}/models with Bearer auth; shows success/failure

name: SQLite Database Initialization
user_story: As a user, I want the app to create and manage a local SQLite database
expected_behavior: DatabaseManager creates ~10 tables (projects, sessions, messages, message_parts, tool_calls, file_changes, undo_stack, providers, messages_fts, schema_version) on first launch

name: Schema Migrations
user_story: As a user, I want the database schema to update automatically
expected_behavior: schema_version table tracks version; runMigrationsIfNeeded runs sequential migrations

name: FTS5 Full-Text Search
user_story: As a user, I want to search messages via full-text index
expected_behavior: messages_fts virtual table with triggers; BM25 ranking; searchMessages and searchWithinSession

name: Database VACUUM
user_story: As a user, I want the database to stay compact
expected_behavior: Weekly auto-VACUUM via performMaintenanceIfNeeded

name: Project/Session CRUD
user_story: As a user, I want projects and sessions persisted across launches
expected_behavior: DatabaseBridge.upsertProject, createSession, loadSessions, archiveSession; all backed by SQLite

name: Undo/Redo Stack
user_story: As a user, I want to undo file operations via an undo stack
expected_behavior: UndoRedoManager with executeWithUndo, undo, redo, history, cleanup; undo_stack table

name: Search Palette UI
user_story: As a user, I want to search tasks via a search palette
expected_behavior: SearchPaletteView sheet with text field; results list filtered via SearchPaletteLogic

name: FTS5 Search Logic
user_story: As a user, I want FTS5-powered search across sessions and messages
expected_behavior: SearchPaletteLogic.matchingSessions uses FTS5 with fallback to title match; searchWithinSession

name: Search Results Display
user_story: As a user, I want to click a search result to open that session
expected_behavior: Button in search list calls appState.selectSession(session) and dismisses sheet

name: Git Repository Detection
user_story: As a user, I want the app to detect git repos in my workspace
expected_behavior: GitRepository.repositoryRoot finds .git directory; GitRepository.currentBranch gets branch name

name: Git Status Display
user_story: As a user, I want to see working tree changes in the UI
expected_behavior: vcsChanges populated from GitRepository.workingTreeChanges; displayed in UI

name: Branch Display & Switching
user_story: As a user, I want to see and switch git branches
expected_behavior: gitBranch property displayed; checkoutGitBranch switches branches; gitBranches list available

name: Commit Changes
user_story: As a user, I want to commit all working tree changes
expected_behavior: commitGitChanges calls GitRepository.commitAll with user-provided message

name: Push Changes
user_story: As a user, I want to push commits to remote
expected_behavior: pushGitChanges calls GitRepository.push; handles upstream setup

name: Auto Git Refresh
user_story: As a user, I want git status refreshed automatically when switching sessions
expected_behavior: scheduleGitRefresh → loadSessionContext → refreshGitFromLocal; coalesced via GitRefreshCoalescer

name: Settings Overlay
user_story: As a user, I want settings as an overlay with dimmed backdrop
expected_behavior: ZStack overlay with black opacity 0.4 backdrop; click outside dismisses; Escape closes

name: General Settings Tab
user_story: As a user, I want to configure theme (dark/light) and language
expected_behavior: Appearance section with theme picker (System/Dark/Light) and language selector (English/Russian)

name: Model Settings Tab
user_story: As a user, I want to configure providers and models
expected_behavior: ModelSettingsView with server providers list and custom providers section; add/edit/remove

name: Skills Management Tab
user_story: As a user, I want to see and install agent skills
expected_behavior: SkillsSettingsView with installed skills list and library from Agent Resource Catalog

name: MCP Server Management
user_story: As a user, I want to configure MCP servers
expected_behavior: MCP servers section with list and install from library

name: Plugin Management
user_story: As a user, I want to see installed plugins
expected_behavior: Plugins section with list of installed plugins

name: User Commands
user_story: As a user, I want to see available slash commands
expected_behavior: Commands section listing .md files from ~/.mimocode/commands directories

name: Remote Connection
user_story: As a user, I want to connect to a remote MiMo Serve instance
expected_behavior: RemoteConnectionSheet with hostname/port fields; calls connectToServe

name: Keychain API Key Storage
user_story: As a user, I want my API keys stored in macOS Keychain
expected_behavior: KeychainManager.saveAPIKey/getAPIKey/deleteAPIKey; fallback file in CI

name: Access Level Permissions
user_story: As a user, I want the app to restrict tool access based on my chosen level
expected_behavior: AccessLevelPermissionLogic maps access level to permission config; synced to server

name: Message Sanitization
user_story: As a user, I want system messages filtered from my view
expected_behavior: MessageContentSanitizerLogic strips <system-reminder> tags from displayed content

name: Data Retention (VACUUM)
user_story: As a user, I want old data cleaned up
expected_behavior: Weekly VACUUM removes deleted rows and compacts database

name: Privacy Mode (Future)
user_story: As a user, I want to hide message content from the UI
expected_behavior: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — future feature

name: DB Encryption (Future)
user_story: As a user, I want database at-rest encryption
expected_behavior: NOT IMPLEMENTED — FileVault covers at-rest encryption

name: Terminal Panel
user_story: As a user, I want a terminal/command panel at the bottom
expected_behavior: BottomPanelView with command input, output display, history

name: Command Execution
user_story: As a user, I want to run bash commands from the terminal
expected_behavior: TerminalLine model with .command/.output/.error types; runs via GitRepository or Process

name: Command Timeout
user_story: As a user, I want commands to timeout after 30 seconds
expected_behavior: 30s timeout in terminal execution; auto-cancels long-running commands

name: Terminal History
user_story: As a user, I want to see previous command output
expected_behavior: Terminal lines preserved in array; scrolled output display

name: Plan/Goal Panel
user_story: As a user, I want to see execution steps and plans in the right panel
expected_behavior: RightPanelView displays currentSteps as task steps; shows when showGoal = true

name: Task Step Display
user_story: As a user, I want to see step-by-step progress of my task
expected_behavior: Task steps rendered with status (pending/in-progress/done); updates via ExecutionStepSyncLogic

name: Image Paste
user_story: As a user, I want to paste images from clipboard into the chat
expected_behavior: ChatPasteCoordinator detects images on clipboard; imports via AttachmentImportExecutor

name: File Paste
user_story: As a user, I want to paste files from clipboard
expected_behavior: PasteboardAttachmentDetector detects file URLs on clipboard; imports as attachments

name: Paste Routing
user_story: As a user, I want paste to go to the right text field
expected_behavior: ChatPasteRoutingLogic directs paste to chat composer or sidebar search based on focus

name: Dark/Light Theme
user_story: As a user, I want to switch between dark and light themes
expected_behavior: appTheme published var with .dark/.light/.system; stored in UserDefaults; sets ZCodeColors

name: Font Scaling
user_story: As a user, I want to adjust font size (zoom)
expected_behavior: settings.zoom.fontScale passed via interfaceFontScale environment; InterfaceTypography.scaled

name: Skill Library
user_story: As a user, I want to browse available skills from a library
expected_behavior: AgentResourceLibraryView shows catalog of available skills from JSON catalog

name: Skill Installation
user_story: As a user, I want to install skills to my workspace
expected_behavior: AgentResourceInstaller copies skill files to ~/.mimocode/skills or workspace .mimo directory

name: Session Creation
user_story: As a user, I want a new session created when I send the first message
expected_behavior: SessionSendLogic.shouldCreateNewSession checks for nil/empty selectedSessionID; createSession via Server

name: Session Persistence
user_story: As a user, I want my sessions remembered between app launches
expected_behavior: Sessions loaded from local DB or CLI on startup; upserted on use

name: Session Archiving
user_story: As a user, I want to archive old sessions to hide them
expected_behavior: archiveSession sets isArchived; archived sessions excluded from active list

name: Session Send Selections Restore
user_story: As a user, I want the app to remember my last provider/model/variant per session
expected_behavior: SessionSendLogic.restoreSelections reads from last user message info; applySendSelections restores

name: Message Feed Hysteresis
user_story: As a user, I want the message list to stay smooth with many messages
expected_behavior: MessageStore pruning keeps visible message count manageable; hysteresis threshold removes old

name: Incremental Message Merge
user_story: As a user, I want new messages merged without re-rendering existing ones
expected_behavior: mergeLatestMessages only updates changed entries; does not clear/rebuild list

name: Lazy Loading / Pagination
user_story: As a user, I want messages loaded in batches for performance
expected_behavior: MessageHistoryPaginationLogic with initialLimit (50) and page size (30); Load More button

name: Git Refresh Coalescing
user_story: As a user, I want git refreshes debounced
expected_behavior: GitRefreshCoalescer runs refresh tasks with deduplication by key

name: Session Busy Recovery
user_story: As a user, I want the app to retry when server is busy
expected_behavior: sessionBusy error caught; abort called; retry after 500ms delay

name: Server Disconnected Error
user_story: As a user, I want a clear message when MiMo Serve is not running
expected_behavior: connectionValidationError returns descriptive string; updated to mention custom provider option

name: Send Validation Errors
user_story: As a user, I want guidance if I forgot to select a model/provider
expected_behavior: sendValidationError returns 'Select a model/provider' strings
